verses.geez: ተጋብኡ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ወስምዑ፡ መላእክት፤ ወትስማዕ፡ ምድርኒ፡ ወእለ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ወዓለምኒ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ አሕዛብ።
verses.translation: Draw near, ye nations; and hearken, ye princes; let the earth hear, and they that are in it; the world, and the people that are therein.

translations.lxx: Draw near, ye nations; and hearken, ye princes; let the earth hear, and they that are in it; the world, and the people that are therein.
translations.kjv: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
translations.ron: Apropiaţi-vă, voi neamuri, şi ascultaţi, şi voi popoare, luaţi aminte; să asculte pământul şi cei ce-l locuiesc, lumea cu toate făpturile ei.
translations.grk: Προσαγάγετε ἔθνη, καὶ ἀκούσατε ἄρχοντες· ἀκουσάτω ἡ γῆ, καὶ οἱ ἐν αὐτῇ, ἡ οἰκουμένη, καὶ ὁ λαὸς ὁ ἐν αὐτῇ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ መዐተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፤ ወመቅሠፍቱኒ፡ ዲበ፡ ኆልቆሙ፤ ከመ፡ ያጥፍኦሙ፡ ወይመጥዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ ኲናት።
verses.translation: For the wrath of the Lord is upon all nations, and his anger upon the number of them, to destroy them, and give them up to slaughter.

translations.lxx: For the wrath of the Lord is upon all nations, and his anger upon the number of them, to destroy them, and give them up to slaughter.
translations.kjv: For the indignation of the LORD is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
translations.ron: Că Domnul este mâniat asupra popoarelor, cu urgie împotriva oştirii lor. El le nimiceşte şi le dă la junghiere;
translations.grk: Διότι θυμὸς Κυρίου ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη καὶ ὀργὴ ἐπὶ τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν, τοῦ ἀπολέσαι αὐτοὺς, καὶ παραδοῦναι αὐτοὺς εἰς σφαγήν.

verses.geez: ወይትገደፍ፡ አብድንቲሆሙ፡ ለቅቱላን፤ ወይጼኑ፡ ጺዓቶሙ፤ ወይርሕሱ፡ አድባር፡ እምደሞሙ።
verses.translation: And their slain shall be cast forth, and their corpses; and their ill savour shall come up, and the mountains shall be made wet with their blood.

translations.lxx: And their slain shall be cast forth, and their corpses; and their ill savour shall come up, and the mountains shall be made wet with their blood.
translations.kjv: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
translations.ron: Morţii lor vor fi aruncaţi pe câmp, cadavrele lor greu vor mirosi şi prin munţi vor şerpui pârâiaşe din sângele lor.
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ τραυματίαι αὐτῶν ῥιφήσονται, καὶ οἱ νεκροί, καὶ ἀναβήσεται αὐτῶν ἡ ὀσμή, καὶ βραχήσεται τὰ ὄρη ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወትጠወም፡ ሰማይ፡ ከመ፡ መጽሐፍ፤ ወይወድቁ፡ ኵሉ፡ ከዋክብት፡ ከመ፡ ቈጽለ፡ ወይን፡ ወከመ፡ ይወድቅ፡ ቈጽለ፡ በለስ።
verses.translation: And all the powers of the heavens shall melt, and the sky shall be rolled up like a scroll: and all the stars shall fall like leaves from a vine, and as leaves fall from a fig-tree.

translations.lxx: And all the powers of the heavens shall melt, and the sky shall be rolled up like a scroll: and all the stars shall fall like leaves from a vine, and as leaves fall from a fig-tree.
translations.kjv: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
translations.ron: Toată oştirea cerului se va topi, cerurile se vor strânge ca un sul de hârtie şi toată oştirea lor va cădea cum cad frunzele de viţă şi cele de smochin.
translations.grk: Καὶ τακήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν, καὶ ἑλιγήσεται ὁ οὐρανός ὡς βιβλίον, καὶ πάντα τὰ ἄστρα πεσεῖται ὡς φύλλα ἐξ ἀμπέλου, καὶ ὡς πίπτει φύλλα ἀπὸ συκῆς.

verses.geez: ሰክረት፡ መጥባህትየ፡ በሰማይ፤ ነያ፡ ትነድድ፡ ዲበ፡ ኤዶምያስ፤ ወትወርድ፡ ዲበ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ሕጉላን፡ ምስለ፡ ኵነኔ።
verses.translation: My sword has been made drunk in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and with judgment upon the people doomed to destruction.

translations.lxx: My sword has been made drunk in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and with judgment upon the people doomed to destruction.
translations.kjv: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
translations.ron: Că s-a îmbătat de mânie în ceruri sabia Domnului şi iată că asupra lui Edom coboară, asupra poporului hărăzit pedepsei.
translations.grk: Ἐμεθύσθη ἡ μάχαιρὰ μου ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ· ἰδοὺ ἐπὶ τὴν Ἰδουμαίαν καταβήσεται, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν τῆς ἀπωλείας μετὰ κρίσεως.

verses.geez: መጥባሕተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጽግብት፡ ደመ፡ ወሥብሕት፡ ሥብሐ፡ አባግዕ፡ ወእምሥብሐ፡ አጣሊ፡ ወሐራጊት፤ እስመ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በባሶር፤ ወዓቢይ፡ ጥብሕ፡ በኤዶምያስ።
verses.translation: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is glutted with fat, with the blood of goats and lambs, and with the fat of goats and rams: for the Lord has a sacrifice in Bosor, and a great slaughter in Idumea.

translations.lxx: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is glutted with fat, with the blood of goats and lambs, and with the fat of goats and rams: for the Lord has a sacrifice in Bosor, and a great slaughter in Idumea.
translations.kjv: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
translations.ron: Sabia Domnului este plină de sânge, acoperită de grăsime, de sânge de miei şi de ţapi, de grăsimea rărunchilor de berbeci. Că Domnul face jertfă la Boţra şi mare junghiere în ţara lui Edom.
translations.grk: Ἡ μάχαιρα τοῦ Κυρίου ἐνεπλήσθη αἵματος, ἐπαχύνθη ἀπὸ στέατος, ἀπὸ αἵματος τράγων καὶ ἀμνῶν, καὶ ἀπὸ στέατος τράγων καὶ κριῶν· ὅτι θυσία τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν Βοσὸρ, καὶ σφαγὴ μεγάλη ἐν τῇ Ἰδουμαίᾳ.

verses.geez: ወይወድቁ፡ ተባዕያን፡ ምስሌሆሙ፤ ወሐራጊትሂ፡ ወአሥዋር፤ ወትሰክር፡ ምድር፡ እምደሞሙ፤ ወትጠልቅ፡ እምሥብሖሙ።
verses.translation: And the mighty ones shall fall with them, and the rams and the bulls; and the land shall be soaked with blood, and shall be filled with their fat.

translations.lxx: And the mighty ones shall fall with them, and the rams and the bulls; and the land shall be soaked with blood, and shall be filled with their fat.
translations.kjv: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
translations.ron: Bivolii cad împreună cu ei, şi boii cu taurii. Şi pământul se îmbată de sângele lor şi pulberea de grăsime este plină.
translations.grk: Καὶ συνπεσοῦνται οἱ ἁδροὶ μετʼ αὐτῶν, καὶ οἱ κριοὶ καὶ οἱ ταῦροι, καὶ μεθυσθήσεται ἡ γῆ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ στέατος αὐτῶν ἐμπλησθήσεται.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኵነኔሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፤ ወዓመተ፡ ፍዳ፡ ኵነኔሃ፡ ለጽዮን።
verses.translation: For it is the day of the judgment of the Lord, and the year of the recompence of Sion in judgment.

translations.lxx: For it is the day of the judgment of the Lord, and the year of the recompence of Sion in judgment.
translations.kjv: For it is the day of the LORD’s vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
translations.ron: Căci aceasta este ziua de răzbunare a Domnului, an de răsplătire pentru pricina Sionului!
translations.grk: Ἡμέρα γὰρ κρίσεως Κυρίου, καὶ ἐνιαυτὸς ἀνταποδόσεως κρίσεως Σιών.

verses.geez: ወይትመየጣ፡ ቈላቲሃ፡ ወይከውና፡ ፔሳ፣፡ ወይከውን፡ ምድራ፡ ተየ፤ ወይነድድ፡ ምድራ።
verses.translation: And her valleys shall be turned into pitch, and her land into sulphur; and her land shall be as pitch burning night and day;

translations.lxx: And her valleys shall be turned into pitch, and her land into sulphur; and her land shall be as pitch burning night and day;
translations.kjv: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
translations.ron: Râurile în păcură se vor preface şi pulberea în pucioasă. Pământul lui va fi pucioasă arzătoare,
translations.grk: Καὶ στραφήσονται αἱ φάραγγες αὐτῆς εἰς πίσσαν, καὶ ἡ γῆ αὐτῆς εἰς θεῖον· καὶ ἔσται ἡ γῆ αὐτῆς ὡς πίσσα καιομένη

verses.geez: መዓልተ፡ ወሌሊተ፡ ከመ፡ ፔሳ፤ ወኢይጠፍእ፡ ለዓለም፤ ወየዐርግ፡ ጢሱ፡ ላዕለ፤ ወትማስን፡ ለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ፤ ወነዋኃ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ትጠፍእ።
verses.translation: and it shall never be quenched, and her smoke shall go up: it shall be made desolate throughout her generations,

translations.lxx: and it shall never be quenched, and her smoke shall go up: it shall be made desolate throughout her generations,
translations.kjv: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
translations.ron: Zi şi noapte. Niciodată nu se va mai stinge în veci de veci şi din neam în neam se va înălţa văpaia şi fumul lui. Pe veci el va rămâne pustiu şi nimeni pe acolo nu va trece.
translations.grk: νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας, καὶ οὐ σβεσθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα χρόνον, καὶ ἀναβήσεται ὁ καπνὸς αὐτῆς ἄνω, εἰς γενεὰς αὐτῆς ἐρημωθήσεται, καὶ εἰς χρόνον πολὺν

verses.geez: ወየኀድሩ፡ ውስቴታ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወቋዓት፡ ወቅንፍዝ፡ ወሆባያት።
verses.translation: and for a long time birds and hedgehogs, and ibises and ravens shall dwell in it: and the measuring line of desolation shall be cast over it, and satyrs shall dwell in it.

translations.lxx: and for a long time birds and hedgehogs, and ibises and ravens shall dwell in it: and the measuring line of desolation shall be cast over it, and satyrs shall dwell in it.
translations.kjv: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
translations.ron: Pelicanul şi ariciul vor fi stăpânii lui, bufniţa şi corbul, locuitorii lui. Şi pe deasupra, Domnul va întinde peste el frânghia nimicirii şi cumpăna pustiirii. Şi oameni cu chip de ţap într-însul vor locui şi de viţă bună socotiţi vor fi.
translations.grk: ὄρνεα καὶ ἐχῖνοι, καὶ ἴβεις καὶ κόρακες κατοικήσουσιν ἐν αὐτῇ· καὶ ἐπιβληθήσεται ἐπʼ αὐτὴν σπαρτίον γεωμετρίας ἐρήμου, καὶ ὀνοκένταυροι οἰκήσουσιν ἐν αὐτῇ.

verses.translation: Her princes shall be no more; for her kings and her great men shall be destroyed.

translations.lxx: Her princes shall be no more; for her kings and her great men shall be destroyed.
translations.kjv: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
translations.ron: Nu se va pomeni acolo de nici un regat şi toţi prinţii lui vor fi nimiciţi.
translations.grk: Οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῆς οὐκ ἔσονται· οἱ γὰρ βασιλεῖς καὶ οἱ μεγιστᾶνες αὐτῆς ἔσονται εἰς ἀπώλειαν.

verses.geez: ወይበቍል፡ ዕፀ፡ ሦክ፡ ውስተ፡ አህጉሪሃ፡ ወውስተ፡ አጽዋኒሃ፤ ወትከውን፡ ሀገረ፡ አጋንንት፡ ወዐፀደ፡ ሰገኖ።
verses.translation: And thorns shall spring up in their cities, and in her strong holds: and they shall be habitations of monsters, and a court for ostriches.

translations.lxx: And thorns shall spring up in their cities, and in her strong holds: and they shall be habitations of monsters, and a court for ostriches.
translations.kjv: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
translations.ron: În palatele lui vor creşte spini, iar în turnurile dărâmate mărăcini şi urgie. Acolo va fi sălaşul şacalilor şi adăpostul struţilor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀναφυὴσει εἰς τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν ἀκάνθινα ξύλα, καὶ εἰς τὰ ὀχυρώματα αὐτῆς· καὶ ἔσται ἐπαύλεις σειρήνων, καὶ αὐλὴ στρουθῶν.

verses.geez: ወይትራከቡ፡ በህየ፡ አጋንንት፡ ወፄደናታት፤ ወይጸርሑ፡ በህየ፡ ኵሎሙ፤ ወየኀድሩ፡ ህየ፡ እየ፡ ሰኰና፡ ላህም፡ ወይረክቡ፡ ሎሙ፡ ምዕራፈ።
verses.translation: And devils shall meet with satyrs, and they shall cry one to the other: there shall satyrs rest, having found for themselves a place of rest.

translations.lxx: And devils shall meet with satyrs, and they shall cry one to the other: there shall satyrs rest, having found for themselves a place of rest.
translations.kjv: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
translations.ron: Câini şi pisici sălbatice se vor pripăşi pe acolo şi făpturi omeneşti cu chip de ţap se vor strânge (fără număr). Acolo vor zăbovi năluci ce umblă noaptea şi în acele locuri îşi vor găsi odihna.
translations.grk: Καὶ συναντήσουσι δαιμόνια ὀνοκενταύροις, καὶ βοήσονται ἕτερος πρὸς τὸν ἕτερον, ἐκεῖ ἀναπαύσονται ὀνοκένταυροι, εὑρόντες αὑτοῖς ἀνάπαυσιν.

verses.geez: በህየ፡ ይትዋለዱ፡ ቅንፍዝ፡ ወታድኅን፡ ምድር፡ ደቂቃ፡ በጽንዕ፤ ወይትራከቡ፡ በህየ፡ ሃየላት፤ ወይትረአዩ፡ ገጸ፡ በገጽ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: There has the hedgehog made its nest, and the earth has safely preserved its young: there have the deer met, and seen one another's faces.

translations.lxx: There has the hedgehog made its nest, and the earth has safely preserved its young: there have the deer met, and seen one another's faces.
translations.kjv: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
translations.ron: Acolo îşi va face şarpele cuibul, şi va depune ouă în el, va cloci şi va scoate pui. Acolo se vor strânge vulturii de pradă şi în acele locuri se vor găsi cu toţii.
translations.grk: Ἐκεῖ ἐνόσσευσεν ἐχῖνος, καὶ ἔσωσεν ἡ γῆ τὰ παιδία αὐτῆς μετὰ ἀσφαλείας· ἐκεῖ συνήντησαν ἔλαφοι καὶ εἶδον τὰ πρόσωπα ἀλλήλων.

verses.geez: ወየኀልፉ፡ በበኆልቆሙ፡ ወኢይትሐጐል፡ አሐዱ፡ እምኔሆሙ፤ ወኢይትኀሠሡ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አዘዞሙ።
verses.translation: They passed by in full number, and not one of them perished: they sought not one another; for the Lord commanded them, and his Spirit gathered them.

translations.lxx: They passed by in full number, and not one of them perished: they sought not one another; for the Lord commanded them, and his Spirit gathered them.
translations.kjv: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
translations.ron: Cercetaţi cartea Domnului şi citiţi, că nimic din acestea nu lipseşte. Căci gura Domnului a poruncit şi suflarea Lui le-a adunat.
translations.grk: Ἀριθμῷ παρῆλθον, καὶ μία αὐτῶν οὐκ ἀπώλετο· ἑτέρα τὴν ἑτέραν οὐκ ἐζήτησαν, ὅτι ὁ Κύριος αὐτοῖς ἐνετείλατο, καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ συνήγαγεν αὐτά.

verses.geez: ወውእቱ፡ ይሁቦሙ፡ መክፈልቶሙ፤ ወእዴሁ፡ አስተዋረሰቶሙ፡ ወይትረዐዩ፤ ወለዓለም፡ ይትዋረሱ፡ ለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ፡ ወየዐርፉ፡ ውስቴታ።
verses.translation: And he shall cast lots for them, and his hand has portioned out their pasture, saying, Ye shall inherit the land for ever: they shall rest on it through all generations.

translations.lxx: And he shall cast lots for them, and his hand has portioned out their pasture, saying, Ye shall inherit the land for ever: they shall rest on it through all generations.
translations.kjv: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
translations.ron: El singur a aruncat sorţii şi mâna Lui le-a împărţit pământul cu funia. Pentru totdeauna ei le vor stăpâni şi în el vor locui din neam în neam.
translations.grk: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπιβαλεῖ αὐτοῖς κλήρους, καὶ ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ διεμέρισε βόσκεσθαι· εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα χρόνον κληρονομήσετε, γενεὰς γενεῶν ἀναπαύσονται ἐπʼ αὐτῆς.
